target_type.description: Trusted logical destination semantics. A Brevo folder is eligible for Project-query sync and creates a managed child List; a list is an existing target and is not eligible for that sync. Null or an omitted legacy field is ambiguous and must not be inferred from the label, default, or destination ID.
target_type.title: Target Type

ProjectPersonalAPIAction.title: ProjectPersonalAPIAction

safe_error_code.description: Always present. Null until a terminal non-success result. DATA does not persist a public materialization cause, so every terminal non-success state uses the documented generic code; raw worker errors are never exposed.
safe_error_code.title: Safe Error Code

audience_detail_url.description: Optional human Audience detail link; browser login and Project access are still required.
audience_detail_url.title: Audience Detail Url

criteria.description: Validated historical selection criteria bound to this plan's evidence; null when unavailable. Revalidate against current query capabilities before creating a new plan; this does not make a stale plan executable.

audience_detail_url.description: Optional human link to the exact source Audience.
audience_detail_url.title: Audience Detail Url

provider_resource_url.description: Optional Brevo console link from this request's actual persisted List ID; null until available. Requires browser login.
provider_resource_url.title: Provider Resource Url

safe_error_code.description: Always present. Null until a terminal non-success result. The API maps approved DATA stages to this closed public taxonomy and maps missing or unknown stored text to project_query_sync_terminal_failure for failed status, or project_query_sync_reconciliation_required for reconcile_required status; raw provider or worker errors are never exposed.
safe_error_code.title: Safe Error Code

ProjectResourceEnvelope.description:
Project-owned Admin projection of a legacy resource during cutover.

The nested shape retains established Admin resource fields, but the route
projection removes legacy Product Scope and physical routing fields before
it crosses the Project contract boundary.
ProjectResourceEnvelope.title: ProjectResourceEnvelope

info.description: Breaking Project authority contract. Project identity is path bound except for authenticated personal-key self-discovery; Product Scope, role ceilings, tenant selectors, provider targets, and plaintext key persistence are not supported.
info.title: Audience Project Control Plane
